name: VRVRVive Raycasting
definition: A two-pass volume raycasting algorithm implemented in a fragment shader for VR rendering, supporting features like Level of Detail (LoD), Early Ray Termination (ERT), Ambient Occlusion (AO), and Cull Planes.
summary: VRVRVive Raycasting is a two-pass, image-order direct volume raycasting algorithm for HTC Vive that decouples ray traversal into normalization and compositing passes to optimize real-time VR performance.
